title: Context Is Not Free: Carbon-Aware LLM Routing for Multi-Turn LLM Web Services across Geo-Distributed Data Centers
abstract: arXiv:2610.35230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint. These services typically run in geo-distributed data centers whose grid carbon intensity varies across regions and over time, so routing each query to a cleaner region or a smaller model can reduce emissions. A conversation, however, is a stateful web session: each turn reuses the key--value (KV) cache of its history, which resides only where earlier turns were served. Serving a turn on another deployment requires recomputing this history, whose carbon cost grows with the conversation and can outweigh the saving of the move. Existing carbon-aware LLM routers treat a conversation's queries as independent and ignore this cost. translated_title: 上下文并非免费：面向跨地理分布式数据中心的多轮LLM Web服务的碳感知路由
translated_abstract: Web的可持续性正受到越来越多的关注，因为基于大语言模型（LLM）的Web服务会留下可观的碳足迹。这些服务通常运行在地理分布式的数据中心中，而各地区的电网碳强度随时间和地域而变化，因此将每个查询路由到更清洁的地区或更小的模型可以减少排放。然而，对话是一个有状态的Web会话：每一轮都会复用其历史记录的键值（KV）缓存，而该缓存仅存在于之前轮次被服务的位置。在另一个部署位置服务新一轮对话需要重新计算历史记录，其碳成本随对话长度增长，甚至可能超过迁移所带来的节省。现有的碳感知LLM路由器将对话中的查询视为相互独立，忽略了这一成本。我们提出了CarbonRouter，这是一个在线框架，它为每个查询联合选择模型、GPU类型和部署区域，以最小化碳排放。CarbonRouter引入了一种……
tldr: 提出CarbonRouter在线框架，首次针对多轮对话的有状态特性，在路由决策中同时权衡模型选择、GPU类型与部署区域，并考虑跨区域迁移时KV缓存重计算带来的隐含碳成本，以最小化LLM Web服务的碳排放。
en_tdlr: CarbonRouter is an online carbon-aware routing framework that jointly selects the model, GPU type, and region for each query in multi-turn LLM web services, uniquely accounting for the hidden carbon cost of recomputing KV caches when conversations span geo-distributed data centers.
